protocol.hypothesis: After a known ZigZag level is crossed, its first later touch and close back in the breakout direction may improve monthly stability compared with immediate breakout.
protocol.parameter_rationale: Wing 3/5 bars and reversal 2/4/6% span medium swings; zone_pct uses two preregistered practical settings. All 12 combinations are evaluated. This is a new use case, not a post-hoc filter of breakout results.
protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and timeframe, filled next open; compare also with separately completed immediate ZigZag breakout run
protocol.signal_rule: After a completed bar crosses a previously confirmed high/low, arm that level. On a later completed bar, enter long if low touches the high within zone_pct percent and close finishes above; symmetric short for low. Use the level only once per breakout; exit if price closes through the opposite side of the latest confirmed level. Fill next open.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Research ranking only; compare the same-stock immediate-breakout experiment and buy-and-hold; no automatic trading approval
limitations: A confirmed pivot is drawn at its historical bar but cannot be traded until wing later bars have closed
Latest ZigZag leg is unstable and is never used as an entry level
Corporate-action coverage is incomplete; results are for research only
Pine chart is for visual review only; Python/Pine parity is unverified
